senses.gloss: f. (שׁוּם I; cmp. סִימָן) mark, mole, wart.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 46a:9">Nidd. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>בן תשע שנים … ש׳</he> if a child nine years old has two hairs (under the arm &c.), it is a mole (and no sign of puberty); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 10:7:6">Y. Yeb. X, 11ᵇ</cite> bot.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 2:4:5">Y. Kidd. II, 62ᵈ</cite> <he>ש׳ שאין בה שיער</he> a mole with no hair; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:9">Tosef. Keth. VII, 9</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 75a:10">Keth. 75ᵃ</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:4">Tosef. Yeb. XIV, 4</cite> <he>מעידין על הש׳</he> we accept testimony (of a husband’s death) on identification by a mole; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 27b:15">B. Mets. 27ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 120a:15">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 120a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ מצויה בבן גילו</he>, v. <cite ref="C00716"><he>גִּיל</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bekhorot 5:5">Tosef. Bekh. V, 5</cite>. B. Mets. l. c. <he>בש׳ סימן מובהק הוא וכ׳</he> they differ as to whether a mole can be considered a distinguishing mark for identification; a. fr.
